title: Aktiviteter på fritiden
request: A clearly visible actual leisure activity with accurate context.

title: Barn och vuxna
request: Distinct non-stigmatizing leisure activity involving adults/children; no private identities asserted.

title: Organiserat eller på egen hand
request: Two source categories, group activity and independent activity, without preference or new rules.

title: Närtjänster
request: Verified Finnish neighbourhood public-service setting.

title: Bibliotek och ungdomsgårdar
request: Actual accurately identified source-listed local institution; not every building claimed to provide every service.

title: Kulturevenemang
request: Actual cultural performance/event, identity and reuse terms verified.

title: En rolig hobby
request: Official source goal of at least one enjoyable hobby for each child/youth; no claim the goal is universally achieved.

title: Hobbyer vid skoldagen
request: Actual school-related hobby activity or materials, without inventing a current programme.

title: Motion, musik och konst
request: Distinct actual sport/music/art objects or activity illustrating the source examples.

title: Andra tider och avgifter
request: Municipal hobby activities outside school day may charge fees; no fabricated prices.

title: Motion och idrott
request: Actual independent sport/exercise scene, no health inference about a photographed person.

title: Jogging
request: Actual jogging image with clear identity/context, distinct from earlier pictures.

title: Ledd motion
request: Actual organized exercise setting, no instructor credential claim beyond metadata.

title: Bildkonst, handarbete och språk
request: Distinct actual handicraft/art/language-learning object/activity, not an invented course advertisement.

title: Föreningsverksamhet
request: Verified actual association meeting/activity, no attendance or membership claim about the viewer.

title: Kommunala lokaler
request: Accurately identified municipal recreation venue, not a private building relabelled public.

title: Förmånligt eller gratis
request: Two source cost categories without invented fees or universal free access.

title: Föreningars tjänster
request: Accurately identified association-run public venue, not an unverified ownership label.

title: Idrottsföreningar och företag
request: Two source providers, no invented current class schedule or named-provider endorsement.

title: Simhall och gym
request: Verified actual Finnish swimming hall or gym, with no specific price asserted.

title: Planer och hallar
request: Actual sports ground/hall, accurate location and public/private context.

title: Sänkta priser
request: Children,pensioners,students and unemployed as source discount groups; no invented amounts or eligibility evidence.

title: Endast kvinnor vissa tider
request: Qualified reserved swimming times, no fabricated timetable or claim about a specific photographed pool.

title: Bastu vid simhallen
request: Actual empty sauna/interior associated with swimming facilities if verifiable; no photographed nudity.

title: Separata bastur
request: Distinct empty sauna or door symbols; no real nude people or unsupported particular venue policy.

title: Invånarhus
request: Verified Finnish residents’/community house with accurate identity.

title: Kommun eller förening
request: Two possible managers, no unverified real-building ownership claim.

title: Klubbar och fria grupper
request: Actual hobby group/activity with licensed source, not a fabricated programme.

title: Hyra för familjefest
request: Empty reservable community room or neutral family-celebration objects, no invented booking offer.

title: Parker och badstränder
request: Verified public Finnish park/playground/beach, no geographic fabrication.

title: Öppet för alla
request: Distinct public green/recreation setting, not an assertion that every visible adjacent property is public.

title: Gemensamt ansvar
request: Visitors and maintained shared space, source concept only.

title: Plocka eget skräp
request: Visible litter bin or clean-up objects/activity, no person accused of littering.

title: Barns och ungas hobbyer
request: Distinct actual child/youth hobby objects or activity; no private identities inferred.

title: Idrott, dans, musik och teater
request: Actual visible source example, event identity and license verified.

title: Avgiftsbelagt och gratis
request: Two hobby cost categories without invented sums.

title: Olika anordnare
request: Municipality,organizations,adult education and private providers as exact source groups.

title: Ungdomsarbetets målgrupp
request: Children/young adults as source audience, without inventing exact ages.

title: Klubbar och öppen verksamhet
request: Actual verified youth-centre activity or facilities, not invented attendance/event dates.

title: Ungdomsgården
request: Distinct accurately identified actual Finnish youth centre.

title: Ledd verksamhet
request: Adult-led activity context, not a claim about unidentified photographed staff credentials.

title: Största delen gratis
request: Qualified mostly-free services, no invented free proportion or waiver of all fees.

title: En vuxen på plats
request: Youth and adult worker presence, no invented staffing ratio or credential.

title: Åldersgränser varierar
request: Different unspecified age limits; no fabricated number.

title: Ungdomarnas önskemål
request: Young people contribute suggestions to activity planning, no universal decision-right rule added.

title: Fråga hemkommunen
request: Verified municipal youth-information setting or neutral contact object, no fabricated contact details.

title: Organisationer och församlingar
request: Accurately identified organization/parish youth venue, no religious identity inferred about users.

title: Motion och nya vänner
request: Actual group sport/social activity without a promised personal outcome.

title: Frivilligarbete
request: Verified volunteer-run sport activity or clearly labelled source illustration; no unverified staff status.

title: Kommunala idrottsplatser
request: Actual verified municipal sports venue, no unsupported ownership inference.

title: Hemkommunens webbplats
request: Generic clearly schematic municipal information screen, no fabricated live website or phone number.
